title: Chapter 453
paragraphs: Chapter 453
Episode 130: New Year, False Rumors, Great Work (2)
"It's clear that there's a problem."
One of the warriors said with a dark expression. He was reporting to Joshua Runcandel, a second-generation Runcandel.
For a while, the cigarette burned in silence. Under the light of the flame, Joshua's face was even more stern than the reporter.
He had never imagined such a thing could happen.
It was none other than the Black Knight.
The strongest guardian knight of the family
, only ten people could wear the black helmet. The Black Knights never failed in their missions.
Even if, by some chance, they failed, they had to find another way or return safely if they encountered a seemingly impossible variable that they couldn't handle alone.
If that was impossible, if there was no choice but to die, they had to leave a message to the family.
In other words, no matter what problem arose, it was impossible for a Black Knight to disappear without a trace.
At least that's what Joshua thought of the Black Knights. Most others thought the same way.
However, several days had passed since the news about the "Black King Group Incident" started pouring out, and the Black Knight who was sent to meet Valkas still had not given any news.
'It's obvious that he was involved in the battle that took place at the Black King Mine...'
The ash-gray smoke from his deep sigh swayed in the darkness.
He wanted to slit the reporter's throat.
He wanted to ask what the point was in scratching their insides by repeating what everyone knew without him having to say it.
There would be no one to blame or criticize him if he vented his unresolved hatred and questions by cutting the reporter.
His fingers holding the cigarette trembled slightly. Five seconds after the intense urge came, Joshua was able to regain his composure without cutting the reporter.
It was a terrible five seconds, as if thousands of insects were crawling all over his body, but during that time, Joshua did not reveal his emotions or flinch.
Being able to control such a horrible urge himself seemed to be a great source of pride.
"I know, so step back. Call Howard."
"Yes, understood."
As the reporter left, Joshua sank back into his thoughts. His eyes were directed at the newsletters piled on his desk.

While the Black Dragon Murakan destroyed the Black King Mine, neither the 12th generation side nor the Black King Group side has yet revealed a clear reason for the war... what are some of the possibilities with high probability in the upcoming development?
Dragons who know Murakan and their contractors continue to refuse to be interviewed or mentioned.
Judging by their very fearful appearance, it's possible that the cause of this incident was simply that the Black Dragon Murakan was in a bad mood...
A thousand years ago, the dragon called the Emperor of the Sky, who terrorized the world... What kind of being is Murakan?
The newsletters were filled with information about Jin and Murakan, especially Murakan.
'If the Black Knight had died.'
Naturally, the likelihood of death by Murakan was the highest.
It is unlikely that the opportunistic Valkas Kran would have participated in the assassination of the Black Knight when the opportunity arose.
Why Murakan?
Like many newsletters, Joshua couldn't come up with a clear answer either.
'No way the youngest would have told Murakan to kill the Black Knight.'
The youngest, the 12th generation.
Joshua had always acknowledged Jin. Even when his other siblings treated Jin as merely a fearless child, Joshua saw the shining talent and potential that the youngest possessed.
The youngest was undoubtedly an outstanding individual.
Not only in talents for swordsmanship, magic, or contracts, but also as a ruler leading a group.
There may be countless virtues of a ruler, but to Joshua, one of the most important was the affection for the subjects.
'In that sense, the youngest would not kill the Black Knight just because he was my man. Never!'
The youngest also loved the Runcandel more than anyone else.

'From what I've heard from my mother, and what I've experienced myself, the Black Dragon Murakan is a very capricious and ferocious being. If Murakan killed the Black Knight, it would have been an accident against Jin's will.'
That meant Jin couldn't properly control Murakan.

However, Joshua soon concluded that it couldn't be the case. If Murakan had escaped Jin's control, there would have been far too many moments when it wouldn't have been strange for a bigger accident to occur.
Kee-ik!
A man with clean white hair and a straight back entered the room. It was Howard, the first-class butler.
"Did you call me, my lord?"
"Howard, what do you think?"
Without any explanation, Howard asked, and he did not look flustered. He already knew what Joshua was pondering.
"There are two possibilities. Death and escape. In my opinion, whichever result occurred, there would be betrayal involved."
Betrayal, as that word came out, Joshua's eyes narrowed.
"Betrayal. That person... the youngest's nanny. Gilly, she was his Orabi, probably. Before becoming a Black Knight."
He recalled the relationship between Gilly and the MacLaren family.
"… And Gilly MacLaren, she seems to harbor great hatred towards the MacLaren family."
"That's how I feel as well."

"There was also a report that the Black Knight had exposed to the youngest the fact that he used Clo in the Sword Emperor City. Then the youngest would have easily deduced that the Black Knight was related to MacLaren."
The youngest betrayed the family and killed the Black Knight.
That's what Howard was saying. Unlike Joshua, he did not believe that the 12th generation truly loved the family.
For Jin, Gilly was more important than the family, so he killed the Black Knight to avenge her and to hurt Joshua.
'Considering how much the youngest cherished Gilly, it seems plausible.'
However, Joshua soon shook his head.
"It's possible, but I don't think the youngest would be that emotional."
"Yes, my lord."
"Probably, the youngest would have helped Gilly take revenge in another way. So, if there's betrayal involved, it's more likely to be someone like Barton Biche."
"The traitor you're talking about."
"Yes. If the Black Knight, who didn't return, was in the same situation as Barton, it would be understandable that the youngest killed him. It would be considered punishing the family traitor."
"My lord, but in that case, it means there's a problem with our cohesion. If it's revealed that there's another traitor among the family's Black Knights..."
Howard trailed off.
Joshua hoped that wasn't the case. If he was the traitor, unlike Barton's case, it meant that Joshua hadn't even grasped it.
Meeting with Howard didn't help clarify anything. In the midst of feeling frustrated, as if searching for a path in the fog, Joshua suddenly realized what he had to do.
"Anyway, the fact that the Black Knight was involved in the Black King's incident hasn't been made public yet. It's the same not only for the general public but also for enemy forces."
Only the Black King's group and Jin's party knew about the Black Knight's existence.
'And the youngest, who loves the family, you would never hand over that information to Zephyr or other forces. Even if it could hurt me greatly, you would prioritize Runcandel's loss first.'
In other words, whether the Black Knight betrayed or not, at least outwardly, Runcandel and Joshua had nothing to lose.
"As long as the 12th generation and the Black King's group keep their mouths shut, there won't be any chance of the information being disclosed."
Of course, they said that because they didn't know about Zephyr's existence.
"We have to make the most of this situation, even though losing the Black Knight is an unspeakable pain for the family."
Howard bowed his head.
"Just give the word."

"Write and distribute a knightly article praising the 12th generation. The narrative should be that the Black King's group lost to Jin and joined under him. It should feel more like a fact than a rumor. It will be unpleasant, but Valkas Kran won't be able to respond recklessly. The fate of the Black King's group is at stake."
"Yes."
"And also distribute an article praising Murakan's might. Spread the rumor that the dragon among dragons is protecting Runcandel, and Zephyr is afraid of him."
This time, even Howard couldn't help but ask.
"...Are you sure it's okay, my lord? It could be like giving wings to the 12th generation. Besides, it provokes Zephyr so much."
"Out of nowhere, the youngest swallowed up a neutral faction that had only been watching each other, one of the largest among them."
Howard bowed his head again.
"It's been several days since such an unbelievable event occurred, and Zephyr hasn't made a proper statement yet. What do you think this means?"
Zephyr doesn't want to fight.
Joshua continued.
"Either they're still afraid of my father, or they're genuinely afraid of Murakan. Either way, Zephyr has given up on the Black King's group. Runcandel took it while they were only watching."
Joshua was able to come up with a response to the case where not Zephyr, but the Black King's group rebels.
"Valkas Kran could also strongly protest. Saying they never surrendered, so why spread such nonsense, and if this continues, they'll entrust themselves to Zephyr."
It was just the question Howard wanted to ask.
"If Valkas comes out like that, we just need to wipe out the Black King's group from the world."
Howard, who realized the meaning a beat later, let out a sigh.

"Zephyr has already hinted that they have no intention of waging an all-out war with Runcandel just to get the likes of the Black King's group. In such a situation, would the Black King's group entrust themselves to Zephyr? If we show an attitude of starting an all-out war, Zephyr will never help the Black King's group."
"I'll carry out the order immediately."
"Good, execute the detailed orders under your direct command."
"Yes, my lord."
As Howard left the room, Joshua leaned back in his chair as if burying himself. When he lit a new cigarette, the sound of the ashes burning seemed unusually loud.
Giving wings to the 12th generation...
Howard's words were echoing in his head.
He was right. With this incident, Jin's position would rise once again.
'But, anyway.'
Everything Jin had and achieved would eventually return to me...
Amidst the gray smoke filling the void, Joshua held onto that conviction.
